description: Oppskyllingslinjer for Hareid kommune etter skred frå Åknes is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Hareid kommune. Oppskyllingslinjer for Brandal, Hareid sentrum og Hjørungavåg grunna flodbølge etter skred frå Åknes. Det er berekna oppskyllingslinjer for to scanerio: 1C (skred på 54 mill. m3 Årleg sannsyn: <1/1000) 2B (skred på 18 mill. m3 Årleg sannsyn: 1/1000) Oppskyllingslinjene dekker ikkje heile kommunens kystlinje. Coverage: Hareid kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Hareid kommune. Its keywords include Hareid kommune, fellesDatakatalog, Samfunnssikkerhet, Local, Det offentlige kartgrunnlaget. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2023-04-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
